roleCatalog.parkedBackendMismatch: IdentityRoleDefinition currently omits applicationAccess and scopePolicy. H3 rejects that response and disables role/scope mutation instead of using local fallback policy.

userType: legacy backend field only; H3 does not derive it from role or use it to filter roles
capabilities: role and scope selection from valid H1 metadata
one-time H2 temporary-password and TOTP provisioning presentation
profile, lifecycle, sessions, MFA status, access review, and audit presentation

globalScope.executiveManagement: H1 returns GLOBAL as the only allowed scope and enforces it

createUser.parkedRequestMismatch: Backend requires userType and activationDeliveryMode, and the ADMIN_ISSUED flow carries adminIssuedHandoffAcknowledged. H3 does not derive userType or silently assert handoff acknowledgement. Backend alignment is required before production creation can integrate.

failurePolicy: Missing, malformed, unavailable, or unknown H1 role metadata disables assignment and scope mutation; production never substitutes the development fixture catalog.
developmentFixture: DEV-only resolver plus explicit isolated test-harness enable flag
secretHandling: oneTimeBootstrap is mapped to in-memory presentation and cleared when the provisioning panel closes
